paper_title: Extensive search for axion dark matter over 1\,GHz with CAPP's Main Axion eXperiment
notes: CAPP-MAX (Main Axion eXperiment) reports the first high-sensitivity axion haloscope search above 1 GHz, scanning 1.025–1.185 GHz (4.24–4.91 μeV). The paper states exclusion limits are set at approximately 90% confidence level assuming axions comprise 100% of local dark matter with density 0.45 GeV/cm³. Figure 22 shows the exclusion plot with gaps due to mode crossings and incomplete analysis. Data points are approximate readings from the described exclusion curve; exact numerical table not provided in excerpt. The coupling values (g_agamma in GeV^-1) are typical for DFSZ axion-photon coupling at these frequencies. Systematic error estimated at ~3% (Appendix B). The experiment uses DFSZ model with coupling coefficient 0.36. | selector: text (sole candidate)
